summary: Iteration 47 — verified the follow-up fix for the fabricated Gaelic 'dhìobhran-dhubha' (aphid) bug. Sonnet-via-`_llm_json` + hand-curated LOW_RESOURCE_GLOSSARY + cache-key bump to v3 all working end-to-end. 7/7 pytest tests pass in 12.8s. Nasturtium gd reason now: "Tha an t-àilleag a' tàladh leumadairean-luibh air falbh o na tomàtothan agad." — contains canonical 'leumadair' root; no 'dhìobhran' / 'dòbhran' leaks. Marigold gd reason contains 'cuileagan-geala' (whitefly). Welsh, French and English paths all clean. Cache-hit path returns byte-identical body. /api/plants?language=gd returns 300+ plants with zero english pest-token leaks.
critical_code_review_comments: core.py::make_translate_companion_reasons — cache key now `companion-reasons:{lang}:v3:{sorted-ids}`; version-suffix pattern is a clean way to invalidate on prompt change.

LOW_RESOURCE_GLOSSARY is defined inside the factory closure — cheap to build once per process (which it is, since the factory is called once at startup), but consider extracting to module level for readability and easier extension.

Cy glossary entry maps 'aphid' → 'pryf blewog / llyslau' (two alternates separated by ' / '). The LLM currently passes the string through verbatim in Welsh reasons (visible as 'pryf blewog / llyslau i ffwrdd o'ch tomatos'). Reads slightly awkwardly to a native speaker — consider picking a single canonical form or wrapping alternates in parentheses.

No TTL / auto-expiry on guidance_cache — pre-v3 rows were manually purged. Suggest a TTL index on `created_at` (or a startup sweep of stale version keys) so future cache-key bumps don't need manual mongo intervention.

If the LLM returns partial/malformed JSON, `reasons_map` silently falls back to the English reason (line 1058-1060). A single logger.warning when an id is missing from reasons_map would surface future regressions quickly.
seed_data_creation: None — tests hit live endpoints. Cache was already warm from prior runs (calls returned in <1s each).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Companion-reasons cache key is `companion-reasons:{lang}:v3:{sorted-ids}` and Sonnet is used (not Haiku). LOW_RESOURCE_GLOSSARY covers gd/cy/ga/mi. If prompt or glossary changes, bump to v4 and either purge pre-v4 rows or wait for cache miss. Regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_companion_i18n_iter47.py covers gd canonical-vocab (leumadair, cuileag-gheal), cy/fr no-english-leak, en still natural, cache-hit determinism, and /api/plants gd payload smoke.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the reported bug (fabricated 'dhìobhran-dhubha'): Haiku was invoked via `_llm_json_cheap` for companion-reason translation and hallucinated a plausible-looking Gaelic word by garbling 'dòbhran' (otter). Mitigation applied by main agent and confirmed by these tests: (a) switched to Sonnet via `_llm_json`, (b) injected a canonical published-vocabulary glossary (aphid=leumadair-luibh, whitefly=cuileag-gheal, …) into the system prompt for gd/cy/ga/mi, (c) bumped cache-key v2→v3 and purged pre-v3 rows so cached fabrications don't re-serve.
